basic_details.job_title: IIFM Special Project Associate Recruitment 2026 – Walkin

qualification.details: Experience in remote sensing and GIS application Excellent writing skills (briefs and research reports) Well conversant in English & Hindi

salary_details.details: During fieldwork, TA/DA will be provided as per the prevailing norms of the Institute. No other allowances are admissible.

how_to_apply: Review the official notification details to ensure eligibility for the desired position.
Send an email to [email protected] by 22.10.2026 to confirm willingness to participate in the interview.
Gather self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials along with the original copies for verification.
Report for the walk-in interview on 22 October 2026 by 10:00 AM at Room No. 106, Indian Institute of Forest Management, Nehru Nagar, Bhopal- 462003.
important_instructions: The registration process for the interview will close strictly at 10:00 AM on 22 October 2026. No TA/DA will be provided to attend the interview. This is a project-related contractual position and has nothing to do with the permanent establishment of IIFM, Bhopal. Based on these positions, any claim for regular appointment in IIFM will not be entertained. The project is funded by Hindalco and titled “Need Identification Cum Baseline Study”. The period of engagement is 04 months from the date of joining or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q1. What is the IIFM Special Project Associate recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in interview recruitment conducted by the Indian Institute of Forest Management, Bhopal, for hiring Special Project Associates on a contract basis for a Hindalco-funded project titled “Need Identification Cum Baseline Study”.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 02 vacancies available for the Special Project Associate positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to confirm participation for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must confirm their willingness to participate via email up to 22.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. When and where is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted on 22 October 2026 at 11:00 AM in Room No. 106, Indian Institute of Forest Management, Nehru Nagar, Bhopal- 462003, with reporting time at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential qualification for SPA Position 1?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate degree in Forestry/Environmental Science/Environment Management/Climate Change & Sustainability Studies with not less than 60% marks, and at least one publication in a reputed journal.
